title: Add storage and routine regression coverage for type arrays
acceptance_criteria: Storage tests prove arbitrary and multi-valued types round-trip with deterministic normalization and legacy scalar data remains readable.
Storage tests prove malformed type values are rejected or repaired without persisting invalid Exercise records.
Routine tests prove one exercise can match each of several type groups and remains selectable, filterable, and clonable.
Existing migration, favorite synchronization, snapshot, and immutability regressions continue to pass.
